label: a variant convicts on its first confirm sample again, so walker noise bills a rework round (the #656 shape)
an unavailable second sample is treated as not reproduced, so a red is silently freed instead of failing closed
old:
else:
    # fail closed: an unavailable second sample keeps the variant conviction
    variant_convicted = list(pending)
    variant = []

label: the reviewer prompt's flaked list runs past the variant heading, so a one-sample variant is presented as an unreproduced first-walk failure
old:
# The flaked lines only: confirm.txt's variant section (1b1) is a different list and must
    # not be read as an unreproduced first-walk failure.
    awk 'NR > 1 && /^variant \(/ { exit } NR > 1' "$UXD/confirm.txt" 2>/dev/null
new:
# The flaked lines only: confirm.txt's variant section (1b1) is a different list and must
    # not be read as an unreproduced first-walk failure.
    tail -n +2 "$UXD/confirm.txt" 2>/dev/null

label: the confirm-only re-ask runs past the variant heading, so it invites a below-3 score grounded in a one-sample variant the gate keeps as evidence
old: echo "These are the first-walk failures the second walk on the same tree did not reproduce:"; awk 'NR > 1 && /^variant \(/ { exit } NR > 1' "$UXD/confirm.txt" 2>/dev/null
new: echo "These are the first-walk failures the second walk on the same tree did not reproduce:"; tail -n +2 "$UXD/confirm.txt" 2>/dev/null
